description_en: Queries the access configurations that are provisioned
description_zh: 调用ListAccessConfigurationProvisionings查询访问配置部署列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso list-access-configuration-provisionings --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00ccule7tadaijxc0000 --target-type RD-Account --target-id 1142405247840000 --provisioning-status Provisioned --next-token K1c3o9K7pFxoTtxH1Nm7MMLb7zrDGvftYBQBPDVv7AD3a8yhRb3Mk8L9ivmN6bFSjfkZNTAg3h40000 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAccessConfigurationProvisionings

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access configuration. The ID can be used to filter access permissions
parameters.help_zh: 访问配置ID，用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task object. The type can be used to filter access permissions.

Set the value to RD-Account, which specifies the accounts in the resource directory.

> You can use the type to filter access permissions only if you specify both `TargetId` and `TargetType`
parameters.help_zh:
任务目标类型，用于查询的过滤条件。

取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号。

> `TargetId`与`TargetType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the task object. The ID can be used to filter access permissions.

> You can use the type to filter access permissions only if you specify both `TargetId` and `TargetType`
parameters.help_zh:
任务目标ID，用于查询的过滤条件。

> `TargetId`与`TargetType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the access configuration. The value can be used to filter accounts. Valid values:

- Provisioned: The access configuration is provisioned.

- ReprovisionRequired: The access configuration needs to be re-provisioned.

- DeprovisionFailed: The access configuration failed to be provisioned
parameters.help_zh:
部署状态，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

- Provisioned：部署成功。
- ReprovisionRequired：需要重新部署。
- DeprovisionFailed：部署失败
parameters.name: provisioning_status

parameters.help_en:
The returned value of NextToken is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If this is your first time to call this operation, you do not need to specify the `NextToken` parameter.

When you call this operation for the first time, if the total number of entries to return exceeds the value of `MaxResults`, the entries are truncated. Only the entries that match the value of `MaxResults` are returned, and the excess entries are not returned. In this case, the value of the response parameter `IsTruncated` is `true`, and `NextToken` is returned. In the next call, you can use the value of `NextToken` and maintain the settings of the other request parameters to query the excess entries. You can repeat the call until the value of `IsTruncated` becomes `false`. This way, all entries are returned
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。首次调用API不需要`NextToken`。

当您首次调用API时，如果返回数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，数据会被截断，只返回`MaxResults`条数据，同时，返回参数`IsTruncated`为`true`，返回一个`NextToken`。您可以使用上一次返回的`NextToken`继续调用API，其他请求参数保持不变，查询被截断的数据。您可以按此方法多次查询，直到`IsTruncated`为`false`，表示全部数据查询完毕
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 20.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~20。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results
